method: Real browser UI acceptance executed with browser automation

checks.name: Register and log in with two accounts
checks.actual: Seller and buyer identities appear in their separate account pages.

checks.name: Upload and publish a product
checks.actual: Uploaded cover, title, and price of CNY 25.50 were saved through the real backend.

checks.name: Reload and log in again
checks.actual: Product title, uploaded cover, and price remain available after refresh and a new login.

checks.name: Search from the buyer account
checks.actual: The product search returns exactly the published test item.

checks.name: Edit and retrieve the product price
checks.actual: Seller updated the price from CNY 25.50 to CNY 19.80; the buyer sees the change after refresh.

checks.name: Reject editing by another account
checks.actual: An API-assisted edit attempt under the buyer session returned HTTP 403; the price remained CNY 19.80.

checks.name: View seller contact details
checks.actual: The contact dialog displays the seller test account email.

checks.name: Complete the buyer and seller transaction flow
checks.actual: Request progressed through pending, accepted, and completed; the product changed from available to reserved to sold.

checks.name: Publish and retrieve a forum post
checks.actual: Post remains after refresh and is accessible from the buyer account.

checks.name: Handle an incorrect login password
checks.actual: Displayed an error (用户名或密码错误) and did not create an authenticated session.
